title: C# Basics
description: Fundamental syntax, type system, control flow, and core methods in C#.

topics.title: Variables & Data Types
topics.description: Value types vs reference types, primitive types (int, double, bool, char, decimal), var keyword, nullable value types, and type casting.

topics.title: Operators & Expressions
topics.description: Arithmetic, logical, relational, bitwise, null-coalescing (??, ??=), and null-conditional (?.) operators.

topics.title: Conditions & Branching
topics.description: if-else, switch statements, switch expressions with pattern matching, and relational patterns in modern C#.

topics.title: Loops & Iterations
topics.description: for, foreach, while, do-while loops, break, continue, and iterations over IEnumerable collections.

topics.title: Methods & Parameters
topics.description: Method signatures, return types, ref, out, in modifiers, params arrays, optional parameters, and expression-bodied methods.

topics.title: Arrays & Strings
topics.description: Single and multidimensional arrays, string immutability, StringBuilder, string interpolation, raw string literals, and Span<T> intro.

title: OOP in C#
description: Core object-oriented programming paradigms, polymorphism, and contracts.

topics.title: Classes, Records & Objects
topics.description: Constructors, primary constructors, fields, auto-properties, init-only setters, record types, and value equality.

topics.title: Encapsulation & Access Modifiers
topics.description: public, private, protected, internal, protected internal, and private protected modifiers; invariant protection.

topics.title: Inheritance & Base Classes
topics.description: Single class inheritance, base keyword, constructor chaining, sealed classes, and object slicing avoidance.

topics.title: Polymorphism & Virtual Members
topics.description: virtual, override, new keyword (shadowing), abstract methods, dynamic dispatch, and runtime method tables.

topics.title: Interfaces & Explicit Implementation
topics.description: Defining interfaces, multiple interface implementation, explicit interface implementation, and default interface methods.

title: Intermediate C#
description: Generics, LINQ, functional constructs, asynchronous programming, and system I/O.

topics.title: Generics & Constraints
topics.description: Generic classes, interfaces, methods, type constraints (where T : class, struct, new(), notnull), covariance and contravariance.

topics.title: Collections & Enumerables
topics.description: List<T>, Dictionary<TKey, TValue>, HashSet<T>, Queue, Stack, yield return, and IEnumerable<T> execution.

topics.title: LINQ (Language Integrated Query)
topics.description: Method syntax vs query syntax, Where, Select, SelectMany, GroupBy, Join, OrderBy, FirstOrDefault, and deferred execution.

topics.title: Delegates, Events & Lambdas
topics.description: Action<T>, Func<T, TResult>, Predicate<T>, multicast delegates, event publishing and subscription, memory leak prevention.

topics.title: Exception Handling
topics.description: try, catch, finally, exception filters (when), custom exceptions, throw vs throw ex, and unhandled exception logging.
subtopics: throw vs throw ex stack preservation

topics.title: Async / Await & Concurrency
topics.description: Task, Task<T>, ValueTask, async/await mechanics, ConfigureAwait, Task.WhenAll, Task.WhenAny, cancellation tokens, and deadlocks.

topics.title: File I/O & Streams
topics.description: File, Directory, Path, FileStream, StreamReader/Writer, using statements (IDisposable), and async file processing.

title: .NET & ASP.NET Core
description: Modern web development with ASP.NET Core, HTTP pipelines, and clean API design.

topics.title: Dependency Injection (DI)
topics.description: Service lifetimes (Transient, Scoped, Singleton), IServiceCollection, factory registration, circular dependencies, and captive dependencies.

topics.title: Middleware & HTTP Pipeline
topics.description: Request pipeline, app.Use, app.Run, custom middleware classes, exception handling middleware, and order of middleware execution.

topics.title: REST APIs & Minimal APIs
topics.description: Controllers vs Minimal APIs (MapGet, MapPost), routing, HTTP status codes, Results/IResult, and OpenAPI/Swagger integration.

topics.title: Routing, Model Binding & Validation
topics.description: Route templates, query string/route/body parameter binding, DataAnnotations, FluentValidation, and automatic 400 responses.

title: Data & Entity Framework Core
description: Data persistence, ORM mechanics, schema migrations, and clean repository abstractions.

topics.title: EF Core Basics & DbContext
topics.description: DbContext, DbSet<T>, OnConfiguring, connection strings, entity state tracking, and SaveChangesAsync.

topics.title: Entity Relationships & Fluent API
topics.description: One-to-one, one-to-many, many-to-many relationships, navigation properties, foreign keys, and OnModelCreating Fluent API configurations.

topics.title: EF Core Migrations
topics.description: dotnet ef migrations add, update, script generation, seeding data, and handling breaking schema changes.

topics.title: Repository Pattern & Data Access
topics.description: Generic and specific repository patterns, Unit of Work, query specifications, and transaction management.
subtopics: repository pattern trade-offs with EF Core

title: Advanced .NET & Architecture
description: Security, automated testing, architecture patterns, SOLID principles, and production deployment.

topics.title: JWT Auth, Claims & Security
topics.description: Authentication vs authorization, JWT token generation, ClaimsPrincipal, policy-based authorization, and CORS setup.

topics.title: xUnit Testing & Mocking
topics.description: xUnit [Fact] and [Theory], Moq/NSubstitute, FluentAssertions, WebApplicationFactory integration testing.

topics.title: SOLID Principles in C#
topics.description: Single Responsibility, Open/Closed, Liskov Substitution, Interface Segregation, and Dependency Inversion in real .NET code.

topics.title: Clean Architecture & Design Patterns
topics.description: Domain, Application, Infrastructure, and API layers; MediatR (CQRS), Options pattern, Factory, and Decorator patterns.

topics.title: Deployment, Docker & Observability
topics.description: Multi-stage Dockerfiles for ASP.NET Core, appsettings.json environments, health checks, OpenTelemetry, and structured logging with Serilog.
